a city-state famous for learning and democracy

questions.q: Write one sentence comparing government in Athens and Sparta.
questions.a: Athens was a democracy where citizens voted, whereas Sparta was ruled by two kings and a council

questions.q: Core: In the portal response box, write a compare paragraph about Athens and Sparta using 'whereas' and 'both'. Starter: 'Athens and Sparta were both ...'
questions.a: Accurate comparisons of government, education and army

questions.q: Extend: Make a fact file for one city with four facts.
Stretch: Which city do you think was more successful? Use evidence.
questions.a: A judgement with evidence, for example Sparta won the war but Athens' ideas lasted longer

questions.q: Which city trained boys as soldiers from age 7?
questions.a: B) Sparta. Spartan boys began army training at about 7.
